study: SOCES: Similarity-Ordered Consecutive-Exclude Stopping with Typed Probabilistic LLMs in Medical Systematic Reviews

M5_structured_decision_logs.description: One row per candidate: review_id, pmid, score, decision, gold_label. Exact 1-token output per decision; zero parse failures.

M6_ai_prompt_disclosure.description: Full V7 noul_relevance typed proposition rubric. No hidden variables.

M7_decision_thresholds.description: Probability cutoff p >= 0.50 (pre-specified on 5-review calibration set). Consecutive-exclude stopping n = 20. No raw similarity floor applied.

M9_human_oversight.description: Human reviewer screens the post-SOCES retained list. AI scores inform but do not constitute final inclusion decisions.

M10_performance_validation.description: Proposition rubric selected via calibration sweep V0-V9 on 5-review calibration set. Operating parameters pre-specified before 70-review evaluation.

prisma_flow_counts.note: Under SOCES n=20, p>=0.50. All records with score < 0.50 are AI-excluded. The 'by AI' PRISMA-trAIce count is the row count in results.csv where score < 0.50.

data_files.results.csv: Per-record scores and decisions (columns: review_id, pmid, score, decision, gold_label). Primary M5 artifact.
data_files.summary.csv: Per-SR confusion matrix and metrics (70 rows).
data_files.n_sweep.csv: SOCES stopping parameter sweep n in {5,10,20,30,50,100,inf} — Table 1 in manuscript.
data_files.cutoff_sweep.csv: Probability cutoff sweep 0.30-0.90 under n=20 — Table 2 in manuscript.
data_files.v7_prompt_review.txt: Full V7 noul_relevance proposition rubric. M6 artifact.
data_files.sr_objectives.csv: SR PMIDs, titles, and stripped research objectives (70 rows). No candidate document text included.
data_files.PRISMA_trAIce_log.json: This file. Structured M5-M10 compliance record.

licence_note: Candidate document titles and abstracts (PubMed text) are not included in this repository. NLM licence prohibits bulk redistribution. Retrieve candidate text using the PMIDs in results.csv via the NCBI E-utilities API (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK25499/). Gold-standard inclusion labels sourced from Bentegeac et al. (2026) dataset, shared with permission from the original authors.
